analyze_flop_count_model: analyze the FLOP count of a PyTorch model using flop_count from fvcore.nn
analyze_flop_count_by_module: analyze FLOP count per module using FlopCountAnalysis and by_module method
test_custom_op_handles: test custom operation handles by passing a supported_ops dict to flop_count
test_conv_flop_count: test FLOP count for 1D, 2D, and 3D convolution layers including grouped and transposed conv
test_batch_norm_flop_count: test FLOP count for BatchNorm1d, BatchNorm2d, and BatchNorm3d operations
